L502: >
L503: > More RAM and VRAM is recommended for advanced usage of Isaac Sim. Isaac Lab usage will require additional RAM and VRAM for training.
L504: >
L505: > [cite465†2 ]
L506: >
L507: > GPUs with less than 16GB VRAM may be insufficient to run a complex scene rendering more than 16MP per frame. Consider upgrading to a higher spec if that is your use case.
L508: >
L509: > [cite466†3 ]
L510: >
L511: > Isaac Sim was tested on these driver versions. See cite467†Technical Requirements†docs.omniverse.nvidia.com for recommended driver versions.
L512: >
L513: > Note
L514: >
L515: >   * The Isaac Sim container is only supported on Linux.
L516: >
L517: >   * An Internet connection is required to access the Isaac Sim assets online and to run some extensions. Allow outbound HTTPS access to `omniverse-content-production.s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com` when using the default online asset root.
L518: >
L519: >   * GPUs without RT Cores (A100, H100) are not supported.
L520: >
L521: >   * Due to VRAM constraints, some tutorials and benchmarks may not run on GPU below the minimum specifications. Workflows leveraging a large number of sensors are particularly affected.
L522: >
L523: >   * See cite468†Linux Troubleshooting†docs.omniverse.nvidia.com to resolve driver installation issues on Linux.
L524: >
L525: >   * We recommend installing the Latest Production Branch Version drivers from the cite469†Unix Driver Archive†www.nvidia.com using the `.run` installer on Linux if you are on a new GPU or experiencing issues with the current drivers.
L526: >
L527: >   * Windows 10 is not supported. Microsoft ended Windows 10 support on October 14, 2025, and no longer provides free security, feature, or technical updates for it.
